description: Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises - Open Data is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPF Economie. There are two types of data files: a complete file: this file contains all the active registered entities and business units registered in the CBE at the time of creation of the file; an update file: this file contains all the changes between the last and previous complete file. Coverage: SPF Economie. The portal shows the English title as "CBE - Open data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPF Economie. Its keywords include BCE, CBE, KBO, ZDU. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.be/license/cbe/open). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
